scheduled_maintenances.name: Scheduled Maintenance – Chatlayer database upgrade

incident_updates.body:
We are writing to inform you that, as part of our continuous efforts to improve the performance and reliability of the Chatlayer platform, we will be performing a scheduled database upgrade at the times specified below.

Type: Scheduled Maintenance – Chatlayer database upgrade

Date: Wednesday, 28th of October 2026

This is a rolling, region-by-region upgrade. No full service outage is expected. Customers may experience brief, intermittent service degradation of up to 1 hour during their region's maintenance window, as the systems cycle through the upgrade.

Windows:
US: 08:00 – 09:00 UTC
South America: 09:00 – 10:00 UTC
India / APAC: 15:00 – 16:00 UTC
EMEA: 06:00 – 07:00 UTC

Impact: Customers may experience brief, intermittent delays to bot responses for up to 1 hour during their region's window. No message loss or extended downtime is expected.

We appreciate your patience and apologize for any inconvenience during this maintenance period. If for any reason the maintenance is extended or rescheduled, we will update this page accordingly.

Please contact support@sinch.com should you require further information or assistance.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Sinch Contact Pro Certificate renewal - CUSTOMER ACTION REQUIRED - EU

incident_updates.body:
Dear Customer,

The Sinch Contact Pro certificate *.cc.sinch.com will be renewed during Sunday November 8th, 2026.

Start time: 2026-11-8 (Sunday) 5 AM UTC
End time: 2026-11-8 (Sunday) 6 AM UTC 

During the maintenance window, all voice channels will experience a short disruption, up to 10 minutes.

Customer Action: 
The certificate authority and the issuer chain will change to Amazon. 
To avoid potential connection issues, Sinch strongly recommends verifying the certificate trust relationship in advance.

How to verify the certificate trust relationship:

Contact Pro UIs (e.g., Communication Panel):
Visit https://certificatetest.cc.sinch.com/, Ensure that no security warnings appear when connecting.

Integrations using cc.sinch.com (e.g., CRM integrations):
Check that your system trusts the new issuer chain. You can also test connectivity using URL https://certificatetest.cc.sinch.com/ .

SIP trunks:
Review your configured trusted issuers to ensure the new issuer chain is accepted.

New certificate details:

CN = cc.sinch.com (*.cc.sinch.com)
Serial: 0A:22:B4:2A:71:41:AF:02:70:2B:81:4A:CC:70:24:EA 
Issuer: CN = Amazon RSA 2048 M04

CN = Amazon RSA 2048 M04 
Serial: 07:73:12:4F:2A:95:2E:3E:D1:8A:58:BD:B8:5D:1B:C0:CE:5F:27 
Issuer: Amazon Root CA 1 

CN = Amazon Root CA 1 
Serial: 06:6C:9F:CF:99:BF:8C:0A:39:E2:F0:78:8A:43:E6:96:36:5B:CA 
Issuer: Amazon Root CA 1 

Certificates are available for download here:
https://clxgroup.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/EXTSinchSharing1/IgC-iGB_R7TkSJzUCFHnT7ulAcom1Bo2RLwLJm9XrAmregQ?e=HNH6tC

For additional information or questions, please contact us via the Sinch Enterprise Support portal:
https://sinchenterprise.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1181 

Best regards,
Sinch Contact Pro Team

scheduled_maintenances.name: Service Announcement & Maintenance: New SMSC Site & Whitelisting Requirements - US Region

incident_updates.body:
We are writing to inform you that the concerned maintenance activity has been postponed to the below mentioned timeframe.

Type: Service Announcement & Maintenance

Previous Start Time: 2026-10-15 07:00 UTC 
Previous End Time: 2026-10-15 08:00 UTC

New Start Time: 2026-12-01 07:00 UTC 
New End Time: 2026-12-01 08:00 UTC

As part of our commitment to platform reliability, security, and scalability, Sinch is adding a brand-new, high-efficiency site to our core SMSC billing and messaging routing engine product. This site expansion introduces a next-generation, high-performance architecture to significantly increase our regional capacity, improve overall platform stability, and ensure robust message processing.

New Regional Connection Endpoints that are planned to go live 2026-10-15 during the aforementioned time window.

US SMPP: us6.smpp.api.sinch.com: 
US HTTP SMS: us6.httpsms.api.sinch.com
US Lookup API: us6.httplookup.api.sinch.com

Action Required: Firewall Whitelisting

To ensure uninterrupted message delivery as we scale our traffic to include this new site we request that you update your firewall settings.

Affected API Endpoint:
(This change only affects customers connecting to either of the following US endpoints)

US SMPP: us1.smpp.api.sinch.com and/or us7.smpp.api.sinch.com
US HTTP SMS: us1.httpsms.api.sinch.com and/or us7.httpsms.api.sinch.com
US Lookup API: us1.httplookup.api.sinch.com and/or us7.httplookup.api.sinch.com

IP Addresses to Whitelist
Please coordinate with your network security team to whitelist these target IP addresses:

35.95.194.74
44.239.11.143
52.32.122.205

If for any reason the maintenance is extended, cancelled, or postponed, we will advise you accordingly.

Please contact support@sinch.com should you require further information or assistance.
